class.soldier.name: Ex-Soldier
class.soldier.description: Years of service taught you to stay calm when things get loud. You hit harder with firearms, and your old training has your back when it counts.
class.butcher.name: Butcher
class.butcher.description: You spent your life working with knife and cleaver. When it comes to close combat you know exactly where to strike, and you are tougher than you look.
class.builder.name: Construction Worker
class.builder.description: Steel-toed boots, hard hat, twelve-hour shifts. You take more punishment than most and do not go down easily.
class.medic.name: Paramedic
class.medic.description: You learned to treat wounds under pressure. Bandages and medicine work much better in your hands than in anyone else's.
class.medic.bonus: +40% healing from Bandage up, bandages and medicine
class.scout.name: Scout
class.scout.description: You know the back routes and find what others overlook. You move faster, get noticed later and pick up more gold.
class.scout.bonus: +10% movement speed, −20% enemy aggro range, +25% gold from loot
settings.touchControlsHint: Shows the control stick and the jump, crouch and target buttons. Automatic detects touch devices. The change applies the next time the game starts.
credits.own.heading: Original content
credits.own.text: The game world, 3D models, textures, logo, icons, interface, sound effects, menu music and the menu background video are original works made for Sektor 7, unless credited otherwise below.
settings.musicHint: Volume of the background music in the main menu.
settings.graphics.hint: Every setting can be switched on or off individually. Changes apply the next time you start the game.
settings.graphics.shadows.hint: Shadows cast by the sun and moon. Costs the most performance.
settings.graphics.lights.hint: Street lamps and fires light up their surroundings.
settings.graphics.flicker.hint: Faulty street lamps and fluorescent tubes flicker.
settings.graphics.daynight.hint: When switched off, it stays day all the time.
settings.graphics.wind.hint: Trees, bushes and grass sway in the wind.
settings.graphics.birds.hint: Flocks of birds in the sky, daytime only.
settings.graphics.dust.hint: Fine dust particles in the air.
settings.graphics.debris.hint: Leaves and scraps of paper blown by the wind.
settings.graphics.fire.hint: Animated flames and sparks on fire barrels.
settings.graphics.smoke.hint: Smoke from chimneys and fire barrels.
settings.graphics.viewDistance.hint: How far you can see into the distance. Works through haze; with haze switched off the view is unlimited. Larger distances cost performance.
